text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
—And so... will you come to my birthday 
party, Brian-chan?♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's not as if there's any particular 
reason why I have to be the one to go.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
My reason? Well, the reason is... Is 
wanting someone special to come not good 
enough?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
To me, a "rival" is someone just as 
precious as a friend♪

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, I have no intention of going. 
I have no interest in cakes or sweets."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Wait, didn't I tell you? For the birthday 
party, we're all going to all-you-can-eat 
yakiniku! ...Is what I meant to say.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's a yakiniku place that's taken care of 
us ever since the Victory Club days for 
after-parties and stuff~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It's reasonably priced, but it's authentic 
charcoal-grilled! The meat is fresh and 
super juicy! And when you pour the shop's 
special sauce over it—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Ah, did you change your mind? Fufu♪ I'll 
teach you my recommended way to grill it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Ngh... You're not doing it right.
